description: A script for manipulating TP-Link tplink2022 image files, including features for decoding headers, extracting sections, creating images, and analyzing or modifying the image container format used by TP-Link devices circa 2022.

methods.name: decode_header(datafile)
methods.description: Reads and decodes the header of a tplink2022 image file into a dictionary, extracting size, item count, and section details.

methods.name: extract(datafile)
methods.description: Extracts sections of the tplink2022 image into separate binary files and preserves leftover data.

methods.name: get_section_contents(section)
methods.description: Retrieves the binary data for a given section, either from inline data, a file, or an empty byte string.

methods.name: write_image(output_image, header)
methods.description: Writes a tplink2022 image file based on a header dictionary, including headers, sections, and a MD5 checksum.

methods.name: encode_soft_verson()
methods.description: Creates a byte sequence representing the software version, but the exact meaning is unclear and possibly unused.

methods.name: create_image(output_image, root, support)
methods.description: Creates a new tplink2022 image file from a root filesystem binary and a support string.

methods.name: main(args)
methods.description: Main execution function supporting image analysis, extraction, and creation based on command-line arguments.
